property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, transfer attempts an external call for each _tos element and returns true iff none of those external calls reverted; if any external call reverts, transfer reverts (so it never returns false).
If C.transfer does not revert for a valid non-empty _tos array, it returns true (i.e., it never returns false).
For any non-empty _tos array, if transfer does not revert then it returns true and does not change this test contract's balance.
For any non-empty _tos, C.transfer either reverts or returns true (never returns false).
